_about: Words a typed name may not contain (#253). 'words' match a whole word only, so 'Cassidy' and 'Dickens' pass; 'inside' match anywhere, so they are long or rude enough to have no innocent hiding place. Names are lowercased, accents stripped, look-alike digits and symbols read as letters, and spacing and repeats ignored before matching. Spaced-out letters ("f u c k") are caught for 'inside' entries only, not for 'words'. Add to the lists, never to the code.
